fields.title: 3. What Touches the Axes and Milestones
fields.md:
- Axis C (capital allocation): the net borrowing increase of about $540 million (estimate) moves both the numerator and denominator of C-2027-1 (cash ÷ total assets ≤25%) by nearly the same amount — the judged figure of 28.9% (9/30, [10-Q](https://www.berkshirehathaway.com/qtrly/3rdqtr26.pdf)) is a quarterly figure, so it is not re-measured this issue.
- No change in judgment for all 14 milestones — this disclosure provides no new measurement unit (quarterly earnings, balance sheet, annual transactions). One 'in progress' line is appended to each status_history (disclosure contents: only Items 8.01 and 9.01 of the [8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526468549/d197844d8k.htm)).
- Among rules R1–R6, none is conditioned on borrowing (source: state.probability_adjustment_rules · rule definitions in the [2026-11 report](2026-11.md)).
